### Agenda

* Daily Scrum meeting to align the team on commit practices and the expected commit frequency.
* Communicate the refactoring of the Java code to the MVC pattern and its impact on the code user stories.
* Review the status of the documentation and data model user stories.

### Updates

* **João Ferreira (Scrum Master):** Facilitated the daily scrum and reminded the team of the commit rules. Updated the domain model to V2 (PlantUML) and the conceptual data model V2 with its USBD03 documentation; the V2 domain model SVG, the USLP01 documentation and QA, and the glossary update follow.
* **Tiago Marquez:** Updated the relational model and its documentation (USBD04) after QA.
* **Francisco Marques:** Created the Shopping app skeleton (USLP03: JDBC connection, DAO, controller and text menu with tests) and fixed the physical model and data after the USBD04 QA (USBD05). Announced that he is refactoring the whole Java project to the MVC pattern.

* Small, frequent commits: each member should commit regularly (at least one commit per class day), one change per commit, instead of large commits at the end.
* Every commit message starts with the issue number (e.g. `#1 ...`).
* Always `git pull` before starting to work and before every push; build and run the tests locally first (pre-commit hook).
* Only the nightly build runs on GitHub Actions; check its report the next day.

### Blockers

* Code user stories (USEI01–USEI05, USLP04–USLP06) are on hold until the MVC refactoring is finished, to avoid merge conflicts and rework.

* Francisco Marques finishes the MVC refactoring and shares the new package structure with the team.
